outcomeNote: A supplementary ruling qualifying the mishna.

segments.he: וְאִי לֵית לַהּ מֵרִאשׁוֹן, אִית לַהּ מִשֵּׁנִי. כְּדֵי שֶׁלֹּא תְּהֵא קַלָּה בְּעֵינָיו לְהוֹצִיאָהּ.
segments.en: The Gemara adds: «And if she does not have» anything «from the first» husband, e.g., if he owned no property, «she» nevertheless «has» a marriage contract «from the second» one, for the same reason that any wife is entitled to a marriage contract in the first place: «So that she will not be demeaned in his eyes such that» he will easily «divorce her.»

moves.summary: she has a ketuba from the yavam, so he not divorce her lightly
moves.about: where the first husband left nothing, the ketuba is owed from the yavam, so she is not lightly divorced

edges.cueHe: ואי לית לה מראשון אית לה משני
edges.about: where the first husband left nothing, the ketuba is owed from the yavam, so she is not lightly divorced

positions.claim: if the first husband left nothing she has a ketuba from the second
positions.basis: so that she not be easy in his eyes to divorce

principlesInvoked: כדי שלא תהא קלה בעיניו להוציאה
